rationale: Approve E3 evaluation ground truth only. Independently inspected the full Golden p8 candidate preview and reproduced candidate SHA-256 0bdd286b671cecfb4db9435da94a5d0f597d547a580e00fb304dd0bd7158003d from the candidate object using canonical key-sorted JSON serialization. Verified 362 sequential words, 100 sequential cells, 25 sequential rows, requires_ocr coverage, valid canonical_v1 geometry for all 462 word/cell boxes, exact one-row membership for every cell, 13 word plus 13 cell U+2013 EN DASH values, no numeric ASCII-hyphen ranges, and preservation of authored hyphens including TIME-AND-MATERIALS and -Any. Approval is limited to e3_benchmark_labels_finalization and grants no production, Project Truth, validator, extraction, deployment, E4 or E5 authority.
